text:
ryan: Heads up — after flipping on lightweight nsys sampling in ded-3 this morning we saw p99 jump ~1.5x for long-seq inference (batch size 1, seq 4k). nvprof traces look clean but timeline shows kernel tailing + CPU-side stalls around KV cache misses.

sam: ugh. is this the full nsys mode or sampling?

ryan: sampling mode (1/1000 requests) with nvtx markers. The sampled traces show a 20–30ms GPU idle gap right after kv_prefetch nvtx region. suspect probe interaction with concurrent kernel scheduling. tried lower sampling, still noisy.

olivia: can you paste the quick tail of the kernel timeline? even a tiny snippet helps.

ryan: sure — this is from a sampled trace: 
```
GPU timeline:
kernel_attn_o  0–8ms
kernel_matmul 8–32ms
kernel_kv_write 32–35ms
<20ms gap>
kernel_matmul (resumed) 55–80ms
CPU: event kv_prefetch at 31ms, syscall at 32ms, context switch 33–45ms
```

anya: so the sampling probe is introducing a context switch on CPU that delays scheduling of the next kernel? :thinking:

sam: we saw this before on machines with aggressive cgroup throttling — perf/ptrace based probes can steal a core briefly. nsys sampling with cpu probes can add jitter.

olivia: would lowering the sampling window or switching to perfetto GPU-only help?

ryan: quick experiments:
- disable CPU-side instrumentation -> p99 back to normal
- reduce sampling ratio from 1/1000 -> 1/5000 -> reduced incidents but now sparse coverage

ryan: overhead estimates from lab runs:
- full nsys tracing: +80–120% token cost (not acceptable in prod)
- lightweight sampling (cpu+nvtx, 1/1000): median +2% but tail increases up to +50ms occasionally
- gpu-only perfetto slices: median <1% and tails smaller, but lacks callstack depth for some kernels

anya: sounds like we need a safe-production guardrail: allow gpu-only tracing in prod, and only enable cpu-instrumentation in canary windows. also add attenuation when p99 > baseline.

sam: agree. propose a policy:
```yaml
profiler:
  mode: gpu-only
  sampling_rate: 0.001
  cpu_probe: false
  dynamic_attenuation:
    enabled: true
    p99_threshold_ms: 1.2 * baseline_p99
    downscale_to: 1e-4
  canary: true
```

olivia: we should also implement a short-circuit: if KV cache miss rate spikes > 5% while profiler active, automatically turn off CPU probes immediately. KV misses correlate with context switches in the sampled traces.

ryan: good call. we'll add a signal hook that monitors kv_miss_rate and p99 delta. also need a rollout plan for the change across Dedicated clusters.

anya: rollout suggestion:
- start on non-prod perf pools with gpu-only tracing for 48h
- enable dynamic_attenuation in staging for 72h with synthetic long-seq workload
- Canary 1% production traffic on a single shard with full gating (kv_miss + p99 + infra alerts)
- Gradual ramp to 10% with attenuation enabled

sam: add telemetry counters: sampling_invocations, cpu_probe_off_triggers, attenuation_events. we need to measure effective visibility loss when we downscale.

deploy-bot: canary deploy queued to ded-2 with profiler flags: gpu_only=true, sampling=0.001

infra-bot: FYI — ded-3 patched kernel driver last week (sched tweak). re-check if regression persists on older kernels.

olivia: one more thought — consider changing probe placement: move KV prefetch NVTX earlier so that if probe blocks, it doesn't coincide with kernel enqueue. small change, might reduce the observed gap.

ryan: noted. i'll run two A/B experiments: probe placement shift and gpu-only traces. planning to collect 24h samples and a perfetto export for perf team.

anya: if you want help setting up the perfetto pipeline and the attenuation rules I can pair with you tomorrow morning.

ryan: thanks — will ping for a pairing session. created a tiny task: https://redwood/tasks/INF-2317 (please add notes).

sam: TL;DR: production-safe default = gpu-only sampling + dynamic attenuation; CPU probes only in tightly gated canaries.

olivia: agree. status: blocking until we verify canary telemetry. :thumbsup:

ryan: updating the runtime config PR now with the attenuation policy and KV miss trigger. will post PR link once ready.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started on ded-2 (id: canary-714). monitor https://console/redwood/observability/canary-714
